EPUB Translator is an EPUB reader for files you import. In-app translation uses Google ML Kit on the device. Translated with Google. Machine translation. Not official. Accuracy is not guaranteed. You may also open the official Google Translate or Yandex Translate apps.

Terms of Use
Last updated: September 13, 2026
1. The app EPUB Translator is a reader for EPUB files that you choose on your device. The app does not include a bookstore or a catalog of books. The app does not distribute books or translations.
In-app paragraph translation is machine translation on the device using Google ML Kit. You may also open the official Google Translate or Yandex Translate apps for a selected paragraph. Translation is not an official edition and not a substitute for a licensed human translation. Accuracy is not guaranteed.
2. Agreement By using the app you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
3. Your files You may open, read, translate, or share only files you have a legal right to use. The developer does not review your files and does not own the copyright in them. Do not use the app to infringe copyright or to publish a translation of a protected work.
4. Translation In-app translation is for personal on-screen display of a selected paragraph. Do not share, export, publish, or distribute translated text created in the app. Translated with Google appears next to in-app translations.
5. Sharing If sharing exists, it sends only the original EPUB you imported, through the Android share sheet. Share that file only if you have the right to share it. The app does not share translations.
6. Credits Reading a book does not require payment. Credits, if shown, are a local limit on in-app paragraph translation. There is no in-app purchase in this version. If paid credits or subscriptions are added later, they will use Google Play Billing and Google Play rules.
7. No license to the book The app does not give you rights in the book you opened. The app is not authorized by the author, publisher, or Google as a publisher of translations. The app does not promise that your use of a specific file is legal.
8. Disclaimer The app is provided as is. To the maximum extent allowed by law, the developer is not liable for indirect damage, lost data, lost profits, a file you chose, a bad translation, or illegal use by you. This does not limit rights that cannot be waived under Israeli consumer law.
9. Copyright contact If you are a rights holder and believe there is a problem with the app itself, email [EMAIL] with your name, the work, and a description of the issue. We can review the app behavior. We cannot delete a file that exists only on a user device.
10. Changes These terms may be updated. The date above will change. Continued use after an update means you accept the new text.
11. Law These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Israel, subject to mandatory consumer rights. Courts: Tel Aviv District, unless mandatory law says otherwise.

Privacy Policy
Last updated: September 13, 2026
1. Who we are EPUB Translator, operated by Stav K. Contact: [EMAIL].
2. What the app does with data The app works mainly on your device. We do not run a book server and we do not upload your book or your translation to a developer server for translation.
Stored on the device only, as needed: - the EPUB you opened - reading position and settings - translation credits balance, if used - translations you asked to show, if cached locally - whether you accepted the translation consent
3. Translation Paragraph translation inside the app runs on the device with Google ML Kit. Book text is not sent to the developer server for translation. Google may receive ML Kit performance or usage metrics under Google policies. That does not mean the developer copies your book to a server.
If you choose Google or Yandex in the paragraph menu, the selected paragraph is sent to that official app on your device. Their privacy policies apply to that action.
4. Purchases This version does not sell credits through Google Play. If purchases are added later, payment data will be handled by Google Play, not typed into this app.
5. Sharing If you share the original EPUB, Android sends it to the destination you pick. We do not host a public link to your file.
6. Who may receive data - Google ML Kit - SDK metrics and model download, not a developer book archive - Google Play - only if you later make a purchase - Android - share or open-in-app actions you start We do not sell user lists.
7. Retention Local data stays on the device until you clear app data or uninstall. Settings may include a way to delete cached translations.
8. Children The app is not directed at children who cannot use an Android device or Google Play without a parent.
9. Contact Privacy questions: [EMAIL].
